description: This is a JUnit test class for the YearStatistics class in a book tracking application. It contains tests verifying functionality such as finding the least and most liked books for the year, and calculating average ratings. The class uses Spring Boot features for dependency injection and assertions through AssertJ.

classes.name: YearStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test suite for the YearStatistics class, validating statistical computations related to books read within a specific year.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by resetting the book database and populating it with sample data.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookThisYear
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly finds the lowest rated book for this year.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies that the system returns empty when searching for the lowest rated book if none exist.

methods.name: highestRatedBookExistsAndIsFound
methods.description: Checks that the highest rated book for this year is correctly identified.

methods.name: testNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies behavior when searching for the highest rated book if none are available.

methods.name: TestNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Checks that the correct number of books read this year is reported.

methods.name: averageRatingExistsAndIsCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that the calculated average rating matches the expected value.

methods.name: haveNoAverageRatingStatisticsWhenThereAreNoStatistics
methods.description: Ensures that no average rating statistics are returned when there are no books for the year.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Helper method to reset the data to a clean state.
